items.title: Google Dismantles 1.3 Million Device XCPE Botnet, Bans Android TV Maker Over Preinstalled Malware
items.description: Google and industry partners have dismantled the XCPE botnet, which enrolled more than 1.3 million set-top boxes through preinstalled malware. In a November 2 report, Google linked the operation with high confidence to Videostrong Technology, accusing the Android device maker of deliberately building and running the backdoor for profit. items.title: Mercado Bitcoin Suffers Cyberattack as Researchers Flag $40 Million in Suspicious Crypto Transfers
items.description: Brazilian cryptocurrency exchange Mercado Bitcoin suspended deposits and withdrawals on November 2, 2026, after detecting a security incident in one of its systems. items.title: Hackers Could Exploit iPhone BootROM Flaws to Compromise Cryptocurrency Wallet Security
items.description: Older iPhones used to store cryptocurrency seed phrases could expose owners to physical attacks that airplane mode cannot stop. OneKey founder Yishi has warned that wiping an aging iPhone and keeping it offline does not make it a secure cold wallet.
